gameDescriptionHtml:
Darfall is a hero-based RPG city-building game that puts you in the role of a hero who must protect their home and help it grow! During the day, grow your hero’s might, find epic loot, master new abilities, and fortify your settlement. At night, survive the hordes of undead, until you triumph.

Game Features

  • Embark on an epic campaign – Stand against the undead hordes in a campaign inspired by fantasy classics. Discover the continent of Aganor across many challenging missions, push back the darkness, and protect your people.
  • Protect your people – Use the day to gather resources, fortify your town, and explore the surrounding lands. When the night falls, defend your people and their homes against the waves of enemies, until the break of dawn.
  • Choose your heroes – Face the challenges with the help of legendary heroes – wizards, warriors, and more. Utilize their varied skills, level them up, and arm them with powerful artifacts won throughout your adventure.
  • Use a powerful scenario editor – Build your own scenarios, maps, quests, and even whole, scripted campaigns with an extensive in-game editor. Share your creations with other players and set your imagination free.
  • Conquer the night in survival mode – Test yourself in a challenging survival mode, where every night brings new, growing terrors. Survive the onslaught, and rebuild every morning to face the undead hordes again. Fight until you win glory… or reprieve in death.
